description: issue #686 (slice I7), spec/interaction-events.md 'Errors and cancellation': a run cancelled before it starts (already-aborted signal) halts with ol-limit/cancelled and emits NO events, even though a key was scheduled for delivery (hostInput). No handler fires after cancellation; nothing is left partially delivered. A fixture cannot express a signal that flips mid-run (that needs a stateful getter, not JSON), so mid-tick cancellation stopping further delivery is proven by the unit test (packages/runtime/src/interaction-dispatch-order.test.mjs); this fixture locks the headless-expressible already-cancelled case.
